label: No Flinch Karasuman
summary: Karasuman no longer goes into his hit-stun when Alucard hits him; his damage, attacks and death are unchanged.

edits.why: EntityKarasuman 'if (hitFlags & 3 && step & 1) SetStep(14)': jal SetStep(14) at 0x2ABD4 -> nop; the 'andi v0,v0,1' word at 0x2ABC8 is included (off==on, vanilla) so unchecking really restores the flinch

vanilla.reason: Vanilla NZ1 holds exactly the off bytes here and the patch is a single nop, so it is safe on vanilla.

notes: Source: sotn_bosses.ppf id karasuman_hit (NZ1 0x2ABD4 d7c1060c 'jal 0x801B075C' -> 00000000); decomp src/st/nz1/e_karasuman.c EntityKarasuman. ASS 1.3.1 (o) ALREADY had its own Karasuman no-flinch: NZ1 0x2ABC8 'andi v0,v0,1' -> 'andi v0,v0,0' (step&1 always false). sotn_bosses.ppf was built against vanilla and writes whole vanilla runs, so applying it put the vanilla 01 back at 0x2ABC8 and nop'd the jal instead; a has andi 1 + nop. So off = VANILLA bytes (andi 1 + jal), not o: o's andi 0 would leave Karasuman unflinching. The run includes the andi word (off==on there) so that unchecking also normalises a 1.3.1-style image; a pure 1.3.1 image (andi 0 + jal) matches neither on nor off here (that is the old alternative implementation, behaviourally 'on'). Other NZ1 o->a changes (map-editor layout data, Double Aggro 0x39BA8.., Reawakened 0x16FC/0x238A/0x2D4C0/0x2E0A0, MP&Hearts 0x1B48/0x36CD0/0x37200) do not touch these bytes. Not emulator-verified here.
